_comment: Golden output of `npm run review -- --force --json --weeks 8` on the scratch fixture in test/e2e.growthreview.test.ts, with Date.now fixed at 2026-10-26T00:00:00.000Z by a test-only preload. reasons.LIST-DISBOARD-A: 3 AM30 of 3 matured, on 8.0 agent-hours and £0.00. Producing; ranked against the portfolio for the scale decision.
reasons.REF: the referral ask has not been made, so nobody has been asked to create a link. EXP-003 is killed on the ask, never on AM30 - with 5 members asked, 0 AM30 would mean 5 is too few to conclude anything.
reasons.PART: no joint night has been run. EXP-004 is measured per night, and Stage-2 vetting is blocked on a human with a Discord account.
reasons.PAID: EXP-008 is locked - no budget exists, £0 spent, no code created. Nothing is running to score.

allocationFindings: Listings took 100% of 12.0 recorded agent-hours, above the 50% ceiling. They are ranked 5th of 6 on expected activation and 1st on convenience; this is the drift roadmap-30d §9 predicts.
Referral and partners took 0% of recorded agent-hours, below the 25% floor. They are the two highest-activation channels in the portfolio and they are being starved.
paidDetail: LIST-DISBOARD-A reached 3+ AM30. That earns the RIGHT TO ASK and nothing else - write the four-part proposal (every free channel's measured cost-per-AM30, the spend as amount and duration, what it should buy in AM30, and the result that would cut it) and put it to the CEO.
